قَمِيصٌ مَنْصُوحٌ , (A, L,) and ↓ مُنْصَاحٌ , (A,) (tropical:) A shirt that is rent (A) and sewed. (L.) [See also مُتَنَصَّحٌ.] ＝
-A2- أَرْضٌ مَنْصُوحَةٌ (tropical:) A land plentifully watered by rain, (K.) having its herbage closely conjoined, (ISd, K,) as though the spaces which were between the several portions of the herbage were closed up by sewing. (ISd.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
